title: Virtual Compute: snapshot review handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute snapshot review scope. Record one approved incorrect review for this exact source using the allocation as related evidence. The source must have approved original untaxed or verified-exempt tax treatment. This review determines the local snapshot subtotal; the separately specified remote protection component enters the final corrected target when the financial correction is handled. For the snapshot review action, evidence event reference and related evidence reference both identify the completed compute-attributable allocation of the original snapshot charge.
